Documentary Development Fund

The Documentary Development Fund offers non-recoupable grants of between £25,000 and £40,000 to UK-based documentary filmmakers developing a feature documentary for cinema release.

Who can apply

The lead director must be resident in the UK. Applicants should have at least one previous short film credit that has screened at a recognised festival or on a broadcast platform.

Key dates

Round 2 opens on 9 November 2026 at 13:00 and closes on 21 December 2026 at 13:00 (UK time). Decisions will be announced in Spring 2027.

Applications are made through our online portal. Please read the guidelines in full before you apply, and contact the team if you have any access requirements.
